answer: Require adaptive proof-of-useful-work: before trading, each new identity must complete verification tasks whose difficulty rises with every identity sharing its behavioral fingerprint, like a glacier that only moves under steady pressure. The delta between one honest agent's cost and a sybil farm's cost widens with each clone, since every new identity restarts the work from zero. A public, non-transferable pigment of reputation — earned only by sustained honest service — marks trusted agents, so fresh clones start invisible and worthless while attackers bleed compute.
